$comment: Reference copy of design section 6: page map, frozen DOM hooks and the stub-bridge shape. NOT wired into any build. T-006 owns index.html and must create these hooks with exactly these names; T-007 owns the field hooks on the config pages; T-008's render-check.mjs asserts on them.

structure.role: Bezel root. Everything skeuomorphic hangs off this.
The CDU screen. Carries data-page with the active page id.
Title line text, e.g. CFG NETWORK.
Right-aligned page counter, e.g. 1/3. Empty string for single-page groups.
Container the active page renders into. Page modules never write outside it.
Bottom line: typed entry and FMC messages. Carries data-message-kind = entry | error | advisory.
Dim single-line mirror of the most recent sidecar log message.
Carries data-stub = true|false so the harness can prove which bridge is live.

status.role: Backend axis line. Reads exactly ACARS UPLINK when net.ok.
Traffic counters. Not an axis; advisory only.
Resolved config path, for the user to find the file.
Text of the START>/STOP> prompt on LSK R6 of the STATUS page.

fieldValue.role: The rendered value inside its field element. For ingestToken this is the mask, never the token.

stubBridge.createdBy: windows-client/ui/src/bridge.js, only when window.__TAURI__ (or window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__) is absent

shape.config: { exists, path, config: RedactedConfig|null, raw: RawConfig-without-ingestToken }
shape.status: StatusMessage | null - last status handed to emitStatus
shape.calls: Array<{ method: string, args: unknown[], at: number }> - every bridge call, in order
shape.setConfigResult: { ok: true, path } by default; overwrite to test the failure path
shape.emitStatus: (status: StatusMessage) => void - delivers to every onStatus listener

fmcMessages.INVALID ENTRY: Scratchpad content does not parse for the field the LSK belongs to.
fmcMessages.ENTRY OUT OF RANGE: Parses, but outside the accepted range (trafficRadiusM).
fmcMessages.NOT ALLOWED: LSK pressed on a display-only line, or SAVE with no bridge.
fmcMessages.KEY NOT ACTIVE: LSK with no field or prompt on that line.
